svg.title: RU-EN-LID Stage 1: candidate expansion
svg.desc: Each word is looked up in an English lexicon, a Roman Urdu lexicon and a list of attested spelling variants; a fixed decision order assigns one of six evidence tags and an Urdu reading. The word itself is never rewritten.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each word is looked up, tagged, and given its Urdu reading. Evidence is added; the word itself is never rewritten.
